title: AI Search Console: Prompt analytics and citation mapping for AI search | Product Hunt
excerpt: AI Search Console helps SEO and GEO teams replace manual AI visibility checks with repeatable data. Track brand mentions, rankings, share of voice, competitors, and cited sources across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Perplexity. Analyze visibility at the individual prompt level, find content and citation gaps, and generate client-ready reports without spreadsheets or screenshots.
